rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Large-Flowered Climber.
Exhibition name: Quick Silver
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tim Hermann Kordes (Germany, 2004).
Introduced in United States by Newflora™ LLC in before 2016 as 'Quick Silver'.
Introduced in Australia by Treloar Roses in 2020 as 'Quick Silver'.
rows.Bloom: Lavender. Mild fragrance. up to 50 petals. Average diameter 3.25". Medium, very full (41+ petals), in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Climbing. Semi-glossy, dark green foliage. 7 leaflets.

Height: 7'1" to 7¼' (215 to 220cm). Width: 47" to 8'2" (120 to 250cm).
